Route 4 — ST185-B-engine (trunk-and-branch)

Rev 2 (2026‑10‑10): bigger main view, numbered key, one detail view (isometric + top) per branch / group. No wiring change. Previous version saved as ROUTE-4-B-ENGINE-rev2.html.

PLANNING ONLY — not committed. Best-fit path on a factory perspective drawing, not measured. Device list from sot/channels.csv (ECU connector B) — not from the old drawings. Bulkhead cavities other than B c18 are PROVISIONAL (plan Section 12).
Layout: Dave’s trunk-and-branch style. The trunk leaves bulkhead B (passenger firewall, beside bulkhead A, above the alternator) and runs along the rear of the block to the driver side (FP1 → FP2 → FP3); a short passenger-side leg (FP0) drops to the oil temp sender and the CAN-Lambda.

Bulkhead B drains: knock = its own pin c18. VSS and the CAN-Lambda CAN pair share c1 (size 12, the only free B cavities are size 12 — RECONCILIATION-RULES): 2 × 20 AWG drains ≈ 17 AWG, spliced to a 14 AWG pigtail crimped in c1 on both halves; cabin side → sp_shield_b → B17. Same signal (drains) only, per the shared-pin rule. Change from §7.3: the ETB motor pair no longer needs a B drain — the ETB is one cable draining to A7 (Section 13.1), and its motor tails at bulkhead B are short and unshielded (approved). B c2 stays spare.

Cabin-only B pins: V-Ethrottle B5, EPS enable B12 (k_eps_en), condenser fan B13, k_acc B10, wheel speeds B19–B21, fuel level B24 (rear), anti-theft B27, ign sense B28, start request B30, A/C B31/B32, APS sub B33. Spare: Inj 5–8, Knock 2, Ign 7. Deleted/excluded: OEM circuit opening relay, injector resistor pack, fuel pump resistor; A6 water-neck A/C switch; OEM knock/EFI items on the factory drawing.
